## Cooler July Inflation Lifts S&P 500 and Dow Futures; Cisco and Applied Materials in Pre-Earnings Focus

Cooling CPI reduces near-term rate pressure and improves risk sentiment heading into CSCO and AMAT earnings; a soft inflation print can amplify positive market reactions to in-line beats, but also raises guidance expectations — execution risk is asymmetric in a good-news macro backdrop.

- July CPI came in cooler — per the headline — driving a rally in S&P 500 and Dow futures.
- Cisco (CSCO) and Applied Materials (AMAT) are specifically named as pre-earnings focal points.
- Netflix also mentioned in the broader roundup context.
- Favorable macro backdrop aligns with two major earnings prints on the same session.
